subject: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: procurement onboarding & PO path
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novacorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: procurement onboarding & PO path

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, NovaCorp is lining up a term renewal and a capacity uplift (+30% committed tokens) that would go into effect 2027-09-01. To keep the rollout on track we need a short procurement path and a couple of confirmations from your side.

What I’ve attached:
- Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (updated scope for +30% capacity, milestone dates)
- SOC2_summary.pdf (brief summary for procurement review)

High-level asks / next steps:
1) Procurement onboarding: if you can add us to your vendor portal or point me to the PO template we’ll populate and return the PO for signature.
2) Pricing & term confirmation: the SOW calls for the existing tier pricing with a 6-month term extension; if that looks good we’ll finalize contract language.
3) Legal review: looping in Lauren and Kimberly on any terms that need redlines.

Target timeline:
- This week: procurement confirms portal link / PO template
- By 2027-07-05: Redwood returns pre-filled PO and DocuSign SOW
- By 2027-07-15: PO signed and billing team notified

If you prefer we can set a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement through the portal flow.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this smooth.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF), SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF)

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novacorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: procurement onboarding & PO path

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the SOW and SOC2 summary — that helps. I’m looping procurement but can confirm a couple quick items:
- We need a completed PO template from your side; procurement will not accept freeform POs.
- Our standard payment term is Net 30 and we use e-invoicing; please confirm billing contact details.

I’ll add our procurement address (procure@novacorp.com) to the thread so they can send the portal invite if needed. Also, can you confirm whether the price in the SOW is final for the committed uplift (or if there’s an account-level discount you’re applying)?

Emily
Emily Zhao
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaCorp
emily.zhao@novacorp.com

Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: procurement onboarding & PO path

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the quick reply and for adding procurement. A few clarifications from legal/ops:
1) Pricing: the SOW includes a one-time volume discount that was approved for this uplift — the price in Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf is final for the committed +30% capacity. We can include the discount as a line item on the PO.
2) Billing contact: finance@redwood.com (AP team) — they accept e-invoice and can support Net 30. Please include "Redwood Inference, Inc." on the PO header and send invoices to finance@redwood.com.
3) Portal link: Emily, here is the standard vendor onboarding URL we use for clients that prefer direct portal access: https://procure.novacorp.com/onboard?vendor=redwood. If procurement prefers, we can also populate and return your PO template directly.

DocuSign and legal: Kimberly, can you review the attached SOW and flag any term language that requires redline? We’re aiming to keep the indemnity and data terms aligned with the existing enterprise playbook — minimal edits preferred so we can meet the July 15 go-live.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: (none)

Hello Rishi / team —

Procurement here. Thanks for the SOW. We attached our PO template (PO_template_NovaCorp.xlsx) — please complete the highlighted fields and return via the portal. Notes:
- We require vendor W9 and a preferred remittance email for e-invoicing.
- Standard terms are Net 30; we need the billing contact and tax ID.
- Please confirm whether Redwood can accept our standard SLA addendum or if you’ll require Redwood’s addendum.

I’ve attached the PO template and set the onboarding portal invite to expire in 7 days; if you need an extension let me know.

Procurement Team
procure@novacorp.com

Hi —

Acknowledged. We will:
- Populate PO_template_NovaCorp.xlsx and upload to the portal today.
- Provide W9 and tax id (Redwood Inference, Inc. EIN: 27-1234567) and remittance: finance@redwood.com.
- Legal (Kimberly) will confirm the SLA addendum compatibility; Lauren/Legal are OK with NovaCorp standard language except for a minor data residency clarification which we’ll note in a short addendum.

Also confirming pricing: the SOW attached earlier is final for the 30% uplift. We will issue the pre-filled PO and DocuSign SOW by end-of-day.

Action items:
- Rishi to upload completed PO and DocuSign envelope (today EOD)
- Kimberly to confirm SLA addendum compatibility (by 2027-07-03)
- Emily / procurement to confirm portal acceptance (portal link acknowledged)

If everyone is fine, I’ll schedule a 15-minute alignment call Friday 07/02 at 10:00 PT to confirm go/no-go for the July timeline.

Thanks,
Rishi
